title: Tracked go/coverage.*.txt are regenerated by ACS predicates every run — guaranteed cross-lane diff noise and out-of-lane tree damage
summary: Wave-3 1572-H2 (HIGH) found three tracked coverage artifacts staged out of lane, with go/coverage.router480.txt truncated 569 lines -> 1 (bare 'mode: set'); 1573-M1 named the mechanism as a class defect: go/acs/cycle464/predicates_test.go:136-138 and go/acs/cycle480/predicates_test.go:141-143 WRITE these git-tracked files as an ACS side effect, so every suite run dirties the tree and an interrupted run leaves a truncated file. Any lane that stages broadly then carries another lane's coverage churn. Fix: stop tracking go/coverage.*.txt (git rm --cached + .gitignore), or redirect the predicates to write under .evolve/runs/<cycle>/. Regression: a repo-contract assertion that no tracked path is written by a test as a side effect of running the suite.
